name: Frog Geyser
text:
Requirements Your mouth is full of water.

---
You can spray a powerful steam of water from your mouth to push your foes around. Filling your mouth with water for your stream requires using an Interact action while next to a source of at least 1 gallon of water. You can hold water in your mouth indefinitely, but while you do, you're unable to speak. When you use Frog Geyser, you shoot water in a 20-foot line. All creatures in the line must attempt a Fortitude save save against your class DC or spell DC, whichever is higher.

---
Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is pushed back 5 feet.

Failure The creature is pushed back 10 feet.

Critical Failure The creature is pushed back 10 feet and knocked Prone.
